findings: Threecollection/commonRESTcontrollerswhole-read/Gitblobverified. No endpoints invoked. Review scoped response/data/lifecycle contracts.

Archive repertoire returns enabled metadata through facade, while download directly returns storedCollection byID without checking enabledflag in this method. Therefore discovery exclusion and direct object retrieval have different state semantics; deployment behavior untested.

Download payload cast directlyString, publish payload directlyCollectionRepertoire; no local type/null/recipe/width validation before delegation. Framework deserialization errors and exception mapping unqualified.

Integrator publish returnsHTTP200 after processCollectionRepertoire, whose percollection failures previously caught/logged. Partialdownload failure can still yield successful overall publication response by source composition; no HTTP runtime test.
Common status response computes online=true when request handled, uses local activeflag; missinglocalnode can dereference null. No separate freshness timestamp in NodeStatus model.
Controllers add no version/recipe validation to downloadedhash workflow. Former finding of metadata/fullcollection collision not resolved here.
